The host's neutral keyed factory owns fresh bounded mounted-CA snapshots with CustomRootTrust, ordinary hostname/chain/time checks and no callbacks/system trust mutation/proxy/cookies/redirects. Global Internet, workers.dev and preview URLs remain disabled; existing class identities, ingress, private foundation handlers, routes and data are preserved. Actual HTTP/TLS components, COM.01 composition and the locked SDK registration are tested with only unavailable endpoints/platform calls replaced. Native AOT image source inclusion, complete actual emitted Worker closure and declared build inputs bind this successor. Dependency coordinates, integrities, lock closure, legal classification, provider/runtime pins and security gates are unchanged; every historical profile and record remains intact. This is reviewed first-party implementation/input admission, not hash-only refresh.
